Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY BASIC package?
The ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY BASIC is a comprehensive preventive health checkup designed to evaluate overall health by assessing blood sugar levels, heart health, liver and kidney function, thyroid balance, vitamin status and complete blood health.
Who should opt for the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY BASIC package?
This package is recommended for individuals looking for routine full body screening, those with a family history of diabetes or heart disease, working professionals, and anyone who wants early detection of potential health issues.
What does the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY BASIC include?
It includes detailed testing for diabetes including HbA1c and blood sugar, lipid profile for heart risk assessment, liver and kidney function tests, thyroid function test, urine complete analysis, vitamin B12 and Vitamin D levels, electrolytes, and complete blood count with ESR.
Why is this package important?
This package helps detect silent conditions such as diabetes, cholesterol imbalance, anemia, vitamin deficiencies and organ function abnormalities at an early stage, enabling timely medical advice and preventive care.
Is fasting required for this package?
Fasting may be required for certain tests, especially blood sugar and lipid profile parameters, to ensure accurate results.
How is the sample collected?
Samples are collected through home sample collection by trained eMedics from Orange Healthcare, ensuring a safe and convenient testing experience.

Booking Procedure:
Select your preferred Orange Health test or package on BookMyTest and complete your booking with your details.
Pick a convenient time slot. A trained eMedic will be assigned and can reach you within 60 minutes of booking or at your scheduled time.
At your selected time, a trained eMedic will visit your doorstep for safe and hygienic sample collection using a painless single-prick method. Samples are securely stored and transported to certified labs for processing.
Doctor-verified reports are shared via WhatsApp, email, and the Orange Health app. You can also access them anytime from your registered account.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY MALE package?
The ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY MALE is a comprehensive preventive health checkup designed specifically for men to evaluate overall health, metabolic balance, organ function and important male health indicators.
Who should opt for the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY MALE package?
This package is recommended for men looking for a detailed full body health screening, working professionals, individuals with lifestyle-related health risks and those who want regular preventive health monitoring.
What does the ORANGE HEALTH FULL BODY MALE include?
It includes tests for diabetes including HbA1c and blood sugar, lipid profile for heart health, liver and kidney function tests, thyroid function testing, iron profile, cardiac risk markers, pancreatic enzymes, prostate screening with PSA, urine analysis, vitamins such as B12 and Vitamin D, electrolytes and a detailed complete blood count with ESR.
Why is this package important for men?
This package helps detect early signs of metabolic disorders, heart risk, prostate-related concerns, vitamin deficiencies, inflammation and organ function abnormalities, supporting timely medical consultation and preventive healthcare.
Is fasting required for this package?
Fasting may be required for certain tests such as blood sugar and lipid profile to ensure accurate results.
How is the sample collected?
Samples are collected through home sample collection by trained eMedics from Orange Healthcare, ensuring a safe and convenient testing experience.
